Watch Showrunners Episode 1: https://nebula.tv/videos/captainmidnight-rod-serling-twilight-zone-showrunners?ref=captainmidnight
Uncle Ben has been the key figure in Spider-Man's origin since 1962, but he's been downplayed since Captain America: Civil War. Now we know, from a Q&A with Joe Russo, that Peter Parker never felt guilt for Ben's death. How does this change MCU Spider-Man? Does it impact how we view Brand New Day?
